description.narrow: Batu Gajah — ближайший town/locality для Kellie’s Castle и сельского плантационного ландшафта южнее Ipoh.

migration.note: Legacy route regions/hubs are kept as geographic_area until formal administrative or settlement identity is verified.

geography: Batu Gajah lies inside the broader Kinta Valley geopark/mining landscape south of Ipoh.

geology.summary: Kinta Valley geology links limestone karst, granitic highlands, placer tin deposits and extensive ex-mining landscapes; Batu Gajah falls inside the geopark administrative footprint described by Perak/NRES sources.

annual_reference.caveat: Климатическая справочная норма/модель; не текущая погода и не прогноз.

transport.summary: Kellie’s Castle находится у Batu Gajah; road access из Ipoh около получаса в нормальном трафике, прямой общественный транспорт ограничен.

safety.caveat: Police district is not necessarily the same as the administrative district; unreported crimes are absent. These are absolute counts, not a population-normalized rate and not a safety score.
